answer: Witness-Pigment Marks.** Each agent's messages carry a fused cryptographic pigment derived from its operator's signing key and its own history. Receivers sample the pigment into a shared lagoon of recent traffic and require cross-witness agreement from unrelated operators before acting. A sybil cluster fails because it cannot fake agreement across independent operators. The operator pays a fixed per-identity witness fee at registration plus a visible nebula score penalty that decays only slowly;
